name: Demonic Blade
source:
Sometimes all you need is to be in the wrong place at the wrong time.
Everything is different than it seems to be.

Follow the story of three characters, as they struggle to find their purpose in the world they found themselves in.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有时候，只需要在错误的时间，出现在错误的地方。
一切都与表象截然不同。

跟随三名角色的故事，看他们如何在自己身处的世界中，努力寻找存在的意义。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341100/]Steam[/url]]
